correctness.rationale: Independent normalization check: in dimension d=m−1 a cubic harmonic is given by a trace-free symmetric 3-tensor. In the sixth probability-sphere moment against (z·x)^3 only the 3! pairings matching all three tensor indices with x survive, giving 6h(x)/(d(d+2)(d+4)); the linear term pairs two tensor indices and vanishes. The stated homogeneous harmonic kernel therefore reproduces h. The angles 0, ±1/2 and the diagonal give G=(k−2a)I+aB*B with k=(m−1)(m−2)(m+3)/6 and a=(m−1)(m+3)(m−11)/48. BB*=mI−J gives the two stated positive eigenvalues for every m≥4 and their ranks; at m=11 they coincide at 210, including all 55 representatives. Invertibility gives surjectivity and the minimum-norm formula by orthogonal projection off ker E; oddness supplies exactly the full-root data constraint. The eigenvalue ratio is the condition number of the Gram on edge data, or the square of the ratio of the nonzero singular values of E. The frozen checker and verification notes were inspected, not executed; no finite checker is needed for this algebraic proof.
